main_conclusion: Metric3D B1 improves model depth, but supported Poisson geometry is effectively unchanged from B0. Preserve supported Poisson as the fixed comparison; add full-training-view sensor TSDF and model TSDF to the next complete pipeline after necessary pose correction. Do not claim TSDF superiority before the comparison.

definitions.reference: Same-capture sensor camera-Z in [0.3,6] m; not independent geometry truth
definitions.foreground: finite positive mesh/model Z < sensor Z - tau
definitions.correct_coverage: Count of correct finite positive hits / ALL reference pixels
definitions.MAE_hit: Mean absolute error conditioned on positive finite hit; must read alongside coverage

model_reference_distance_bands.warning: MODEL depth only; mesh-by-distance bands not published in the inspected result.

B0.method: Known B0 legacy per-view PLY blocks, pixel recovered within 0.1 pixel of the native center.

B1.method: Original sampled indices captured during B1 export

interpretations.claim: Filtering improves true correct coverage despite some lost coverage.
interpretations.basis: B1 raw -> supported coverage 99.999% -> 92.101%, correct <=10cm 6.016% -> 59.023%. Fixed reference denominator counts misses as incorrect.
interpretations.qualification: Raw-to-supported combines selection, fusion, depth change and face crop; cannot assign entire gain to only one change.

interpretations.claim: The raw Poisson result adds severe foreground occlusion beyond model depth failure.
interpretations.basis: B1 model first Z<0.3m 0.172% vs raw mesh 58.830% of reference pixels; raw local desk is entirely occluded by a near-camera surface.
interpretations.qualification: Does not prove a single axis/normal sign bug or identify each offending point's origin.

interpretations.claim: Both upstream learned geometry and export/fusion remain bottlenecks.
interpretations.qualification: PCD nearest-z projection has sampling gaps and is not a continuous surface; its metric is not direct proof of corrupt backprojection.

interpretations.claim: More Poisson depth is not the immediate priority.
interpretations.basis: Supported B1 already has a nominal 1.20cm finest cell and 9.53M faces, but held-out hit MAE is 20.51cm and <=10cm correct coverage is 59.02%.

next_complete_task.prerequisite: Use corrected/frozen geometry version after any confirmed local pose repair; training improvements coordinated with main review.

sensor_tsdf.depth_source: Native depth-camera Z at native grid; undistort to the same depth camera's own pinhole grid if needed, never use sparse RGB forward-mapped depth as the TSDF integration image.
sensor_tsdf.pose: T_world_depthCV = T_world_rgbCV @ T_rgbCV_depthCV, using verified metric depth-to-RGB calibration; integration extrinsic is its inverse.
sensor_tsdf.camera: Native depth pinhole K after any native-grid undistortion. Do not apply the RGB K or RGB half-pixel conversion to an already-CV-native K.
sensor_tsdf.color: NoColor geometry integration suffices for this diagnostic; any RGB coloring must be calibrated onto the native depth grid.
sensor_tsdf.meaning: Input-data/pose geometry reference, not independent GT or a guaranteed upper bound.

model_tsdf.depth_source: Final model predicted RGB-camera Z, not replacement sensor Z
model_tsdf.candidate_mask: Finite predicted Z within [0.3,6] m and alpha>=0.5; no held-out reference and no sensor-consistency rejection. Use RGB pinhole K, dense eligible pixels and record counts.
model_tsdf.comparison_limit: Different input masks plus dense integration versus sensor-filtered randomly sampled Poisson points are explicit pipeline differences; this is not a pure single-operator ablation.

integration_conventions.existing_open3d: Reuse pinned 0.18 environment; no dependency upgrades needed
integration_conventions.intrinsics_rgb: For an Open3D integer-pixel-center API, cx_cv=cx_ns-0.5 and cy_cv=cy_ns-0.5; do not reuse boundary-coordinate intrinsics unchanged
integration_conventions.intrinsics_depth: Use actual depth-camera own undistorted K with its documented pixel convention; do not apply RGB center offset twice.
integration_conventions.fair_evaluation: Both final meshes evaluated from frozen RGB holdout cameras against the same existing RGB registered sensor-Z reference mask.

next_complete_task.retained_comparator: Same supported Poisson protocol; preserve raw Poisson only for method-protocol audit
next_complete_task.selection: Predeclare validation criterion: all-reference correct coverage at 5/10/20cm plus foreground fraction, missing fraction and same-camera visual checks. Select main practical export using validation, then report frozen test once.
diagnostics_in_one_pass: All val/test metrics with unchanged reference denominators
Sensor-reference bins [0.3,2),[2,4),[4,6] for every final mesh
